arguments.need: I want to talk instead of type and have my words land wherever my cursor is, in any app. I need the speech recognition to happen on my own machine rather than being shipped off to some server, and it has to be free and open source. Ideally there'd be a second shortcut that tidies up my rambling (drops the ums, fixes it when I correct myself mid-sentence) using a local model I run through Ollama, and shows me the cleaned text to approve before it gets pasted.
